decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted proposal have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 5 - The existing typical mortar should be analysed and the results used to inform the grades of sand and lime to be used.The samples of lime putty specification together with proposed performance, and final finish of the repointing shall be more fully identified and agreed with the local planning authority before implementation.
description: Rebuilding of existing patio, replace existing soil rent pipe, repair of existing joinery, painting of railings and waste pipes and walls , removal and refitting of rear access stairs. New basement door and repairs to brickwork of building.
